basic_details.job_title: ABV IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management Gwalior (ABV IIITM Gwalior) has released the official notification for the post of Junior Research Fellow. The last date to apply online is 21 October 2026. Candidates can apply through the official website, iiitm.ac.in.

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified to shortlisted candidates via email

how_to_apply: Visit the institute website at www.iiitm.ac.in.
Fill out the online application form available via the Google Form link: https://forms.gle/vg5RZpEWnbmD7pAL8.
Submit the application before the deadline of 21 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: ABV IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management Gwalior
End-to-End Deep Learning Model for Pulmonary Nodule Detection and Risk Characterization in Early Lung Cancer Screening
Initially for one year, extendable till completion based on satisfactory performance reviewed every 06 months

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: An applicant having a master’s degree in engineering/technology/electronics/mechatronics or any other equivalent qualification (MSc/MCA/MS in relevant field/branch and 10+2 with mathematics) recognized by the Institute with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA of 6.5 on a 10-point scale in the qualifying degree. Applicant with qualified GATE/NET will be preferred. Desirable Qualification: Applicant working Image Processing and Computer Vision, Machine Learning and Deep Learning, Pytorch and Python Module will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a consolidated stipend of ₹ 20,000 per month. The appointment is purely temporary, governed by the terms and conditions of the funding agency and the Institute, and is initially for one year. It may be extended further till the completion of the project based on satisfactory performance on reviews conducted every 06 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ABV IIITM Gwalior Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Visit the institute website at www.iiitm.ac.in. Fill out the online application form available via the Google Form link: https://forms.gle/vg5RZpEWnbmD7pAL8. Submit the application before the deadline of 21 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview date. In case of receiving many applications, the committee may put higher criteria for shortlisting. The interview for shortlisted applicants will be conducted in an offline or online mode at ABV-IIITM Gwalior.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Junior Research Fellow position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and is initially for one year, which may be extended further till the completion of the project based on satisfactory performance reviewed every 06 months.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any age limit criteria specified for the JRF post?
faq.answer: No age limit is stated in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email about the interview date. If many applications are received, the committee may apply higher shortlisting criteria.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview for shortlisted applicants will be conducted in an offline or online mode at ABV-IIITM Gwalior.

faq.question: Q5. What are the preferred qualifications for this position?
faq.answer: Applicants with a qualified GATE/NET, as well as those working in Image Processing and Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Pytorch, and Python Module, are preferred.
